name: proto-oneof-go-wrapper
description: A Go oneof member is read where hand code tells it apart: a type-switch case naming its wrapper type, a type assertion to the wrapper, and a comparison of the Which result with its case constant, written by the hybrid API. A nil arm and a default clause read nothing further, a wrapper composite literal only writes its member, and a comparison of the oneof field with nil tells no member apart, so it reads every member of that oneof.
pending: references-go.15: deadset-go reads a oneof member by its wrapper type in a type switch or assertion and by its case constant against a Which result (GO5).
